requirements.quote: Prices shall be unconditional. Statements such as 'to be discussed', or references to a separate contract, disqualify an offer
requirements.text: Prices must be unconditional, and certain statements or references can disqualify an offer.

requirements.quote: Offers shall stay valid for at least four months after the submission deadline
requirements.text: Offers must remain valid for at least four months post submission deadline.

requirements.quote: The successful bidder shall provide a performance guarantee of 10% of contract value at signature. A pre-financing guarantee shall cover up to 30% of the price if pre-financing is requested
requirements.text: Performance and pre-financing guarantees are required from the successful bidder.

requirements.quote: The successful bidder shall also provide performance and payment bonds in a form the Owner approves
requirements.text: Performance and payment bonds must be provided in an approved form.

requirements.quote: Liquidated damages shall reduce prices when service level requirements are missed, capped by an at-risk amount: a percentage of monthly recurring prices for continuous services and a per-service cap for discrete services. Delay penalties scale with the length of the delay and the seriousness of the breach
requirements.text: Liquidated damages and delay penalties apply for service level failures.

requirements.quote: Commercial exceptions shall be listed in a separate schedule. Exceptions on payment, cancellation charges, warranty or liquidated damages are assessed for economic risk and can make a bid non-responsive
requirements.text: Commercial exceptions must be listed separately and may affect bid responsiveness.

requirements.quote: Warranty is included within the five-year maintenance period, and component warranties run inside it
requirements.text: Warranty is included in the five-year maintenance period.

requirements.quote: Failures caused by disturbances that are foreseeable within the interface limits of Section 9 are the Contractor's responsibility
requirements.text: Contractor is responsible for foreseeable failures within interface limits.

requirements.quote: The Contractor shall guarantee supply-chain security for each component for the expected lifetime of the system, with a risk plan and mitigation for sensitive components
requirements.text: Supply-chain security must be guaranteed for the system's lifetime.

requirements.quote: Bidders shall state the share of work they subcontract. Subcontractors above 15% of price, or whose capacity is needed to qualify, shall sign the confidentiality agreement and give a written undertaking to make their resources available
requirements.text: Bidders must disclose subcontracting details and ensure subcontractor compliance.

requirements.quote: Entities subject to applicable sanctions or restrictive measures shall not take part in any capacity
requirements.text: Sanctioned entities are prohibited from participation.

requirements.quote: The bidder bears all costs of bidding. The Owner may abandon the procurement before signature without compensation
requirements.text: Bidders bear bidding costs, and the Owner may cancel without compensation.

requirements.quote: Information exchanged is confidential and used only to prepare the bid
requirements.text: Bid information is confidential and for bid preparation only.

requirements.quote: Annual turnover over the last two closed financial years shall exceed one-third of the lot value, combined across a group, supported by profit and loss accounts
requirements.text: Annual turnover must exceed one-third of the lot value over two years.

requirements.quote: Manufacturers shall have at least five years designing, building and testing the offered equipment for data centers, and shall supply a reference list of installed units
requirements.text: Manufacturers need five years of experience and a reference list.

requirements.quote: Each bidder shall provide three reference forms for work executed in the previous four years, at least one from the bidder itself rather than another entity
requirements.text: Three references are required, with at least one from the bidder.

requirements.quote: Lot 6 references shall be AI installations with at least 500 AI-optimised GPUs tightly interconnected on a low-latency network, with storage suited to AI workloads
requirements.text: Lot 6 references must involve specific AI installations.

requirements.quote: Lot 2 and Lot 3 references shall be data center or utility installations of comparable power-conversion or distribution scale at the offered voltage class
requirements.text: Lot 2 and 3 references must match specific installation criteria.

requirements.quote: The bidder shall run a support centre in the site's region for more than two years, serving at least two similar clients with at least six English-speaking staff
requirements.text: A regional support center with specific capabilities is required.

requirements.quote: The bidder shall hold relevant certifications, such as ISO 9001 quality, ISO 27001 security, ISO 14001 environmental management and ISO 45001 safety
requirements.text: Relevant certifications are required for the bidder.

requirements.quote: Experts with at least three years in role, each a different person, shall cover systems architect, systems engineer, data center infrastructure specialist, application and benchmarking specialist, and project manager
requirements.text: Specific expert roles with three years of experience are required.
